property.name: content
property.value:
# Paths and the local management port are supplied by Basic Settings. data_directory = '{{data_directory}}' hba_file = '{{hba_file}}' ident_file = '{{ident_file}}' port = {{port}} unix_socket_directories = '{{socket_directory}}'
listen_addresses = 'localhost' max_connections = 100 shared_buffers = '128MB' work_mem = '4MB' maintenance_work_mem = '64MB' wal_level = replica max_wal_size = '1GB' min_wal_size = '80MB' checkpoint_completion_target = 0.5
logging_collector = on log_directory = 'log' log_filename = 'postgresql-%a.log' log_min_duration_statement = -1 log_line_prefix = '%m [%p] ' password_encryption = 'scram-sha-256'
property.description: Complete postgresql.conf. Keep the documented management placeholders and local health access. Save a configuration version and restart the service to apply. Nginx also supports RELOAD.
